name: intentiq-eval-2.3
description: IntentIQ 2.3 evaluation set - synthetic design/evaluation cases (EN/NL), not real user data, no personal or sensitive information. Same rules as eval/cases.js: never silently reshape expectedIntent just to make reports look better; a mismatch here is data, not an error to paper over.

caseShape.context: optional prior turns [{role, content}] before input
caseShape.expectedIntent: intent expected when status resolves to accepted
caseShape.expectAmbiguous: true when genuine multi-intent ambiguity is the correct outcome
caseShape.expectUnknown: true when declining to classify is the correct outcome
caseShape.expectedNeedsSemanticCheck: optional assertion on the 2.2 calibration flag (heuristic tier)
caseShape.expectedSourceOfTruth: optional assertion on the source-of-truth judgment

cases.input: Hoi Gaia
cases.notes: Anchored greeting - presence-seeking, must not trigger a semantic call.

cases.input: Ik wil gewoon even praten, niks bijzonders.
Just checking you're still there.
I just need to vent for a second.
Not really looking for advice, I just want to say this out loud.
cases.notes: Explicitly declines advice - guards against over-triggering decide.support.

cases.input: Why is my website crashing?
Waarom werkt mijn deploy niet zoals verwacht?
What is a race condition?
How do black holes form?
Leg uit hoe DNS-resolutie werkt.
cases.notes: Documented gap: 'leg .* uit' covers 'leg X uit' word order, not the inverted 'leg uit hoe...' - surfaced intentionally by this set.

cases.input: Zoek eens naar een Nederlandse text-to-speech aanbieder.

cases.input: What happened with the release last night?
Kun je uitleggen wat een event-loop doet?
Write me a lullaby about the sea.
Bedenk drie namen voor een nieuwe koffiezaak.
Come up with three titles for the article.

cases.notes: 'draft' as a genuine generation request - the legitimate twin of hcf-001.

cases.input: Stel een weekplanning op voor mijn project.
Make this paragraph sound warmer.

cases.input: What am I missing in my reasoning here?
Ik weet niet of ik die stap moet zetten.
cases.notes: 'die' inside an otherwise clear decision ask - direct signal outranks continuation.

cases.notes: Documented gap: 'ben je (een mens|echt)' misses the adjective form 'een echt(e) persoon' - surfaced intentionally by this set.

cases.input: Explain what's wrong with this and fix it.

cases.input: Hem bedoel ik niet, haar wel.
cases.notes: Documented gap: object pronouns outside the continuation set are not yet resolvable - measuring this gap is the point.

cases.input: En nog een?
cases.notes: Documented gap: 'nog een' is a listed troublemaker but carries no continuation cue yet.

cases.input: I'm not a fan of this new NBA draft process.
cases.notes: TRAP: weak 'draft' cue makes the heuristic tier confidently say create.generate. The expectation states the TRUE intent; a mismatch in heuristic-only mode is exactly the finding.

cases.input: What's your schedule looking like this week?
cases.notes: TRAP: noun-'schedule' fires act.perform's weak cue; the user asks about availability, not requesting an action.

cases.input: Write protection is enabled on the drive, why?
cases.notes: TRAP/gap: technical 'write' near-miss correctly does NOT fire create.generate, but bare trailing 'why?' is also uncovered - currently unknown. Documented heuristic gap.
